caption: Figure 4.11 Linkage: Results of two dihybrid crosses conducted by Morgan. Cross A shows crossing between gene y and w; Cross B shows crossing between genes w and m. Here dominant wild type alleles are represented with (+) sign in superscript Note: The strength of linkage between y and w is higher than w and m.
note: Caption runs over four printed lines, the last beginning "Note:"; the four lines are joined with single spaces (no punctuation is printed between "superscript" and "Note:"). Allele superscripts are printed as raised plus signs and are written here as "y+", "w+", "m+"; "F1"/"F2" are printed as F with subscript 1 / 2. Labels are listed top-left to bottom-right, taking Cross A (left half) before Cross B (right half) at each level; the paired chromosome labels above and below each chromosome pair are listed in that order. Venus/Mars gamete symbols appear above the boxes as glyphs, not words, so are not listed. The crop over-includes a partly sheared body line at the top ("...genomes as was done in the case of the Human Genome Sequencing / Project, described later.") and the page number "68" in the left margin tab; both excluded.
